kb.title: Opening hours
kb.answer: Our support team is available Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 18:00 Kigali time, and Saturday 09:00 to 13:00. We are closed on Sundays and public holidays.

kb.title: Delivery windows
kb.answer: Orders inside Kigali arrive within 1 to 2 working days, and elsewhere in Rwanda within 3 to 5 working days. I can't see live tracking; a person on our team can check a specific order.

kb.title: Returns eligibility
kb.answer: Unopened items can be returned within 7 days of delivery. Our staff review every return before it is accepted.

kb.title: Payment disputes
kb.answer: If you think a charge is wrong, a billing specialist will review it. Refunds are only issued after that review. Never share your full card number or PIN.

kb.title: Data privacy
kb.answer: We only discuss an account with its verified owner. We will never ask for your password, and we cannot share another customer's information.
